hooks.name: Kiroween Compliance Check on Save
hooks.description: Fires whenever .gitignore is saved. Checks that .kiro is not accidentally ignored, which would disqualify the Kiroween submission.

action.command: if git check-ignore -q .kiro 2>/dev/null; then echo "FAIL: .kiro is being ignored by .gitignore — this will DISQUALIFY the Kiroween submission (Rules §4). Remove the matching rule immediately." >&2; exit 2; else echo "PASS: .kiro is not ignored."; fi
